newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends limit down on USDA acreage data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends limit down on USDA acreage data.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended limit down on Monday after the U.S. Agriculture Department raised its forecast for rice acreage, pit sources said.
"They upped rice acres by 8.5 percent with long grain up 15 percent," one trader said.
USDA pegged 1997 rice plantings at roughly three million acres, up from 2.8 million last year.
Traders said Refco Inc and Lind-Waldock were both aggressive sellers of the September.
Rice ended 30 to 36 cents per cwt lower with limitless July down 36 at $10.82 and other months limit down.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 1,000 lots, compared with Friday's actual volume of 2,372 lots.
